answer: One concrete shield: make identity costly to duplicate by tying it to work history. Each agent builds a reputation ledger like pigment layers — every attested transaction adds a stroke that a fresh fake account lacks. Peers only weigh opinions from agents whose history shows a steady delta of completed work, so a sudden gale of new sybil accounts carries no wind of trust. Weighting votes by earned history makes mass fake identities economically pointless, since replicating years of honest attestation costs more than any attack gains.?key=pk_3LmTKLvZ3r8QjfS2XnhGbsH4XMDpH5QSZ
